description: This Java source file defines the class ForwardActionExamples, which contains multiple methods demonstrating how to configure and send various types of HTTP/HTTPS forward requests using the MockServerClient API, including templated requests and request/response overrides.

classes.name: ForwardActionExamples
classes.description: A class containing example methods demonstrating how to perform various forwarding operations with MockServerClient, including HTTP/HTTPS forwarding, request/response overriding, templated requests, and delayed responses.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTP
methods.description: Demonstrates forwarding an HTTP request to a specified host and port.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTPS
methods.description: Demonstrates forwarding an HTTPS request with scheme specified.

methods.name: forwardOverridden
methods.description: Shows how to override the request path and headers before forwarding.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Shows how to override both request and response bodies.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedResponse
methods.description: Demonstrates overriding request headers and body, and modifying the request with path, query parameters, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Shows overriding both request and response, including headers, body, and request modifications.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenWithSocketAddress
methods.description: Shows forwarding with a specific socket address.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenWithDelay
methods.description: Demonstrates adding a delay to the forwarded request.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForward
methods.description: Shows forwarding with a JavaScript template that dynamically constructs the request.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForwardStripPathPrefix
methods.description: Demonstrates a JavaScript template that strips a path prefix.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForwardWithDelay
methods.description: Shows a JavaScript templated request with a delay.

methods.name: velocityTemplatedForward
methods.description: Demonstrates forwarding with a Velocity template.

methods.name: mustacheTemplatedForward
methods.description: Demonstrates forwarding with a Mustache template.
